mapper.insert: INSERT INTO APPROVAL_DOC ( DOC_ID, KIND, RETENTION, DISCLOSURE, RESTRICT_REASONS, RESTRICT_DETAIL, RECEIVER_TYPE, RECEIVER, VIA, REFERENCE_TO, SENDER, EFFECTIVE_DATE, TITLE, BODY, STATUS, DRAFTER_ID, DRAFTER_NAME, DRAFTER_POSITION, DRAFTER_DEPT, CREATED_AT, SUBMITTED_AT, DELETED_YN, BUDGET_ID, PAY_AMOUNT, PAYEE, PAY_METHOD ) VALUES ( #{docId}, #{kind}, #{retention}, #{disclosure}, #{restrictReasons}, #{restrictDetail}, #{receiverType}, #{receiver}, #{via}, #{referenceTo}, #{sender}, #{effectiveDate, jdbcType=DATE}, #{title}, #{body, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{status}, #{drafterId}, #{drafterName}, #{drafterPosition}, #{drafterDept}, #{createdAt}, #{submittedAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, 'N', #{budgetId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{payAmount, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{payee}, #{payMethod} )
